Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner first misidentified the president as Warren G. Harding (the Versailles Treaty defeat involved Woodrow Wilson). This factual error derailed the reasoning and was compounded in the next step by asserting Wilson had no children, despite Wilson having three daughters (Margaret, Jessie, and Eleanor). The initial misidentification at Step 3 marks the first mistake that led toward the wrong solution.
